mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a built-in grill and a freestanding grill?

acceptedAnswer.text: A built-in grill is permanently integrated into a custom outdoor kitchen island or structure, offering a seamless, custom-designed aesthetic and often connected to a natural gas line and other utilities. Freestanding grills are mobile units that sit on their own cart, typically using propane tanks, and can be moved. Built-in grills provide a more luxurious, integrated cooking experience and can increase property value, while freestanding grills offer flexibility and are generally a more economical option upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: A built-in grill is permanently integrated into a custom outdoor kitchen, offering a seamless look and utility connections, while a freestanding grill is mobile and sits on its own cart.
